- Participants aged 12–15 may attend alone only with written permission.
- Participants aged 16 or older do not need written permission.
- Everyone must book a seat, including accompanying adults."},{"case_id":"modes-en-025","text":"You may assign at most two qualified volunteers to the extra shift. Volunteering does not guarantee assignment. Anyone already rostered for the overnight shift is ineligible, even if qualified."}]}
